action.description: Action to perform. 'normalize_flow_map' and 'project_paths' are planned but not yet implemented.

threat_actor.description: Threat actor name, alias or ATT&CK id (profile_actor). Resolved against groups, then campaigns, then software — e.g. 'Cozy Bear', 'G0016', 'APT29'.

software_scope.description: How much of the actor's associated-software technique mapping to return, as a block separate from the actor's own techniques (profile_actor). 'delivery' keeps only techniques whose tactics include resource development, initial access, execution, persistence or command and control — the stages where the actor's own tooling determines the technique. 'all' includes post-compromise techniques too, which are dominated by behaviour any actor would perform with whatever is already on the host. 'none' returns the actor's directly attributed techniques only.

intel_artifact_id.description: Optional threat_intel_ingester json_events artifact whose mitre_mappings are unioned into the technique set. Covers actors ATT&CK does not document (profile_actor).

max_procedures.description: How many procedure examples to return per covered tactic (profile_actor).

flow_map.description: Inline flow map conforming to schemas/flow_map.schema.json (validate_flow_map). Supply this or 'flow_map_artifact_id'.

flow_map_artifact_id.description: Id of a json_events artifact holding a flow map (validate_flow_map). Supply this or 'flow_map'.

file_path.description: Path to a JSON flow map file (validate_flow_map). Injected by the shell when 'flow_map_artifact_id' is given.
